points.description: The student gives 10 cents as the cost of each pump. Equivalent working is accepted, such as 2400 cents ÷ 240 pumps (120 washings × 2 pumps), or 20 cents per wash ÷ 2 pumps. The mark requires every step to be valid and the final answer to be 10 cents, so a wrong step or a wrong final answer earns no mark.

rubric.notes: The question has a single numerical answer and the model answer makes the mark all-or-nothing, so there is one point worth 1 mark with no partial credit. Full marks go to a valid method ending in 10 cents per pump, with the unit given in cents or clearly equivalent. Any invalid step or an incorrect final figure earns no mark.
